entities.summary: Myślenice is a town in southern Poland situated in the Lesser Poland Voivodeship, 30 km south of Kraków. The town is divided into six districts. The most popular of them, Zarabie, is a famous tourist destination. It is located behind the Raba river, next to Chełm district on the slope of the hill of the same name, where is a view tower and a landscape park and ski lifts.
